svg.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, Noto Sans, sans-serif
svg.title: 4. Control, measurements and diagnostics
svg.desc: PD_READY is derived from a valid EPR contract plus fresh raw-PD ADC data. MOTOR_PG is a separate eFuse signal.

g.title: U16: RP2040
g.desc: Firmware checks freshness, supply state and latched faults before allowing motion.

svg.text: state and latched faults before allowing

g.title: U2 / U3: PD policy
g.desc: TPS26750 APP/sink/EPR contract; EEPROM stores configuration. U36 isolates programming bus.

g.title: U38: INA237 raw-PD ADC
g.desc: PD_VBUS before eFuse; independent of protected motor-bus voltage.

g.title: U30: ADS1115
g.desc: VMOTOR divider, eFuse current monitor and J3 brake-return preflight.

g.title: U31 / U32: phase-current sense
g.desc: Inline shunts + INA240. Diagnostic samples, not motor current regulation.

svg.text: Inline shunts + INA240. Diagnostic samples, not

g.title: U29: TMP102
g.desc: Board temperature and hardware TEMP_OK output.

g.title: U18: optional AS5600 (DNP)
g.desc: Angle telemetry only; rear magnet interface unqualified. No closed-loop motion claim.

g.title: U7: DRV8462DDVR
g.desc: SPI setup; STEP/DIR/nSLEEP commands; nFAULT and HOME feedback.

g.title: U35 / U37: status outputs
g.desc: RGB and buzzer with reset-domain buffer. Indicators do not implement hardware protection.

g.title: SW1 / SW2: local controls
g.desc: Reset and local START/STOP. Qualification locks still prevent motion.
